statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm and capture continuous data over the monitoring period
The patient has diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to service delivery
